essence: Therefore this offering-mantra grants victory to everyone.
Therefore one distributes meat to the dog groups with an angry mind.
Therefore by this practice a king effortlessly obtains victorious fortune.
Therefore these beings stand in cremation grounds repeatedly across times and cities.
Therefore even devotees of the left-hand path proceed by a course of non-hatred.
